literature.headline_zh: 乙型肝炎病毒本期文献呈现多方向研究进展
literature.lead_zh: 本期乙型肝炎病毒研究集中呈现以下进展。
key_findings_zh: 该综述得出的结论是,NA 疗法显着改善了 HBV 感染的移植受者的预后,减少了肝移植的需要,并将移植后的结果从差转为优。此外,它还指出,接受 NA 治疗的 HBV 肾移植受者的结局与未患有 HBV 的患者相当。 [10.1111/tid.70299]
该综述强调了 HBV-VLP 在逆转 慢性乙型肝炎 免疫耐受和构建肝脏靶向智能递送平台方面的潜力。它还讨论了多价共展示策略在解决 HBV-VLP 免疫逃逸问题方面的转化潜力。 [10.13345/j.cjb.260367]

与未参与数字化活动和辅导的药剂师相比,完成数字化培训并参与数字化活动和辅导的药剂师储存 HBsAg-RDT 的可能性高出 2.83 倍,并且他们的 HBV 相关知识和信心明显更高。在同一六个月期间,84% (98/117) 的药房在转诊到附近的医疗机构进行确诊性 HBV 诊断 之前,使用 HBsAg-RDT 筛查了 2,840 名独特客户,其中 270 名药房客户的检测呈阳性。 [10.1371/journal.pgph.0007137]

在中位12.6年随访期间,45例患者(14.1%)发生HCC。多变量分析显示,术后1年4COL7S在校正基线mPAGE-B、术后1年HBsAg-HQ及术后1年HBcrAg后,仍独立关联后续HCC发生(调整后风险比[HR] 1.167;95%置信区间[CI] 1.001–1.344;p=0.042)。M2BPGi‐Qt显示一致的辅助预测价值(调整后HR 1.272;95% CI 1.101–1.468;p=0.001)。 [10.1111/hepr.70266]
该审查强调,世卫组织美洲区域只有 23% 的慢性乙型肝炎患者得到诊断,4.5% 的患者得到治疗,这突显了覆盖率和交付精确度之间的重大差距。HBV 消除被认为是低表观 患病率 条件下的系统交付挑战,需要从以覆盖范围为中心的方法转变为以精度为中心的方法。 [10.1080/14787210.2026.2723574]

literature.lead_en: This reporting window highlights the following research developments.
key_findings_en: The pooled sensitivity and specificity of DBS-based HBsAg testing were 0.943 (95 % CI, 0.916–0.962) and 0.988 (95 % CI, 0.980–0.993), respectively, with a pooled DOR of 1,995.07 (95 % CI, 834.68–4,768.66). Subgroup analyses showed that specificity remained relatively stable across most subgroups. [10.1515/cclm-2026-1075]

The review concludes that NA therapy has significantly improved outcomes for HBV-infected transplant recipients, reducing the need for liver transplantation and transforming post-transplant outcomes from poor to excellent. [10.1111/tid.70299]

The review highlights the potential of HBV-VLPs in reversing immune tolerance in chronic hepatitis B and constructing liver-targeted intelligent delivery platforms. It also discusses the translational potential of multivalent co-display strategies for solving immune escape issues in HBV-VLPs. [10.13345/j.cjb.260367]

Pharmacists who completed the digital training and were engaged with digital campaigns and coaching were 2.83 times more likely to stock HBsAg-RDT and reported significantly higher HBV-related knowledge and confidence compared to non-engaged pharmacists. [10.1371/journal.pgph.0007137]
During a median follow-up of 12.6 years, 45 patients (14.1%) developed HCC. [10.1111/hepr.70266]

news.headline_zh: 乙型肝炎病毒本期公共卫生新闻动态
news.lead_zh: 本期乙型肝炎病毒新闻集中呈现以下动态。
key_findings_zh: 一篇文章讨论了乙型肝炎和丙型肝炎治疗之间的根本区别,强调乙型肝炎的基因组整合使得真正的病毒学治愈比丙型肝炎清除更加复杂。本文由医学博士 Raymond Chung 和医学博士 Douglas Dieterich 撰写。 [news-95f776cd78fb8d48]
一项新的国际研究合作项目 B-ZERO 获得了 Wellcome Trust 发现奖,该项目旨在调查为什么一些乙型肝炎患者尽管接受了 治疗 治疗仍无法抑制病毒。这是根据报告中描述的研究计划确认的事件。 [news-62de91ea2116ec27]
该文章强调了《美国管理护理杂志》报道的乙型肝炎护理中未满足的需求和长期 抗病毒药物 安全性。 [news-0361880749369d5a]
讨论乙型肝炎护理中未满足的需求和长期 抗病毒药物 安全性,重点关注初级保健机构中指南的不一致和 治疗 阈值。 [news-03833ddbba50b6dc]
一篇综述挑战了对隐匿性乙型肝炎感染的传统理解,表明 突变 的组合,而不是单一的基因变化,可以解释尽管存在具有复制能力的 HBV DNA,但 HBsAg 检测呈阴性的现象。这是一个合理的假设,而不是一个既定的机制。 [news-6c47418b1a7a902d]

news.lead_en: This reporting window highlights the following Hepatitis B virus news developments.
key_findings_en: An article discusses the fundamental differences between hepatitis B and hepatitis C cures, emphasizing that hepatitis B's genomic integration makes a true virologic cure more complex than hepatitis C clearance. The article is authored by Raymond Chung, MD, and Douglas Dieterich, MD. [news-95f776cd78fb8d48]

A new international research collaboration, B-ZERO, has secured a Wellcome Trust Discovery Award to investigate why some hepatitis B patients fail to suppress the virus despite receiving treatment. This is a confirmed event based on the research initiative described in the report. [news-62de91ea2116ec27]
The article highlights unmet needs and long-term antiviral safety in hepatitis B care, as reported by The American Journal of Managed Care. [news-0361880749369d5a]
Discussion on unmet needs and long-term antiviral safety in hepatitis B care, focusing on guideline inconsistencies and treatment thresholds in primary care settings. [news-03833ddbba50b6dc]

A review challenges the conventional understanding of occult hepatitis B infection, suggesting that combinations of mutations, rather than single genetic changes, may explain the phenomenon of negative HBsAg tests despite the presence of replication-competent HBV DNA. [news-6c47418b1a7a902d]

papers.title: ALG-020572, an Antisense Oligonucleotide for the Treatment of Chronic Hepatitis B Virus Infection Discontinued for Drug-Induced Liver Injury.
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Current treatment options for chronic HBV infection are suboptimal in that they fail to suppress HBsAg levels. ALG‐020572 is an antisense oligonucleotide designed to reduce viral protein synthesis through degradation of HBV mRNA. ALG‐020572‐401 was a double‐blind, randomized, placebo‐controlled trial consisting of two parts. Part 1 (single‐ascending doses) evaluated the pharmacokinetics, safety and tolerability of single doses of ALG‐020572 or placebo in healthy participants. In Part 2 (multiple dosing), participants with non‐cirrhotic HBeAg‐negative, virologically suppressed chronic HBV infection were administered up to 7 doses of ALG‐020572 to evaluate safety, pharmacokinetics and antiviral activity. In Part 1, 32 participants were randomized to ALG 020572 or placebo. Single doses of ALG‐020572 up to 480 mg were well tolerated. The most common treatment‐emergent adverse event reported was injection site reaction. ALG‐020572 was rapidly absorbed and plasma exposures increased with dose. In Part 2, 8 participants with non‐cirrhotic HBeAg‐negative virologically suppressed chronic hepatitis B infection were enrolled and received up to 7 doses of ALG‐020572. The study was prematurely discontinued after 4 participants experienced significant alanine aminotransferase elevations that were subsequently attributed to drug‐induced liver injury. Single doses of ALG‐020572 demonstrated a favourable pharmacokinetic and safety profile in healthy participants. Unexpectedly, ALG‐020572 was poorly tolerated in participants with chronic HBV infection, resulting in the early termination of the study and further development of ALG‐020572 due to idiosyncratic drug‐induced liver injury, suggesting caution is required in the development of this class of drugs. Trial Registration: Registered at clinicaltrials.gov : NCT0500102

analysis.research_question_and_background: Current treatment options for chronic HBV infection are suboptimal in that they fail to suppress HBsAg levels. The study aimed to evaluate the safety and antiviral activity of ALG-020572 in patients with chronic HBV infection.
analysis.study_design_and_population: ALG-020572-401 was a double-blind, randomized, placebo-controlled trial consisting of two parts. Part 1 evaluated single doses in healthy participants, while Part 2 involved participants with non-cirrhotic HBeAg-negative, virologically suppressed chronic HBV infection. In Part 2, 8 participants were enrolled and received up to 7 doses of ALG-020572.
analysis.methods: The study involved administering single and multiple doses of ALG-020572 to healthy participants and those with chronic HBV infection. Safety, pharmacokinetics, and antiviral activity were assessed through monitoring adverse events, plasma exposure levels, and viral protein synthesis.
analysis.main_results: Single doses of ALG-020572 up to 480 mg were well tolerated in healthy participants. However, in participants with chronic HBV infection, the drug was poorly tolerated, leading to the premature discontinuation of the study due to drug-induced liver injury.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings suggest that ALG-020572, despite showing a favourable safety profile in healthy participants, may have idiosyncratic effects in patients with chronic HBV infection, necessitating caution in its development.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The results highlight the need for careful evaluation of antisense oligonucleotides in patients with chronic HBV infection, particularly regarding potential liver toxicity, which has implications for drug development and patient safety.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study was prematurely discontinued, limiting the ability to fully assess long-term safety and efficacy. The evidence is moderate due to the limited sample size and early termination.

analysis.summary_en: This study evaluated the safety and antiviral activity of ALG-020572, an antisense oligonucleotide designed to reduce HBV protein synthesis, in patients with chronic HBV infection. Part 1 of the trial assessed single doses in healthy participants, showing a favourable pharmacokinetic and safety profile. Part 2 involved participants with non-cirrhotic HBeAg-negative, virologically suppressed chronic HBV infection, but the study was prematurely discontinued due to drug-induced liver injury. The results indicate that while ALG-020572 is well tolerated in healthy individuals, it may cause unexpected adverse effects in patients with HBV infection, raising concerns about its development. The findings suggest caution in the use of antisense oligonucleotides for HBV treatment and emphasize the importance of monitoring for liver toxicity in clinical trials. papers.title_zh: ALG-020572,一种针对 慢性乙型肝炎 病毒感染的 治疗 的反义寡核苷酸,因药物引起的肝损伤而停产。
papers.source_body_en: ABSTRACT Current treatment options for chronic HBV infection are suboptimal in that they fail to suppress HBsAg levels. ALG‐020572 is an antisense oligonucleotide designed to reduce viral protein synthesis through degradation of HBV mRNA. ALG‐020572‐401 was a double‐blind, randomized, placebo‐controlled trial consisting of two parts. Part 1 (single‐ascending doses) evaluated the pharmacokinetics, safety and tolerability of single doses of ALG‐020572 or placebo in healthy participants. In Part 2 (multiple dosing), participants with non‐cirrhotic HBeAg‐negative, virologically suppressed chronic HBV infection were administered up to 7 doses of ALG‐020572 to evaluate safety, pharmacokinetics and antiviral activity. In Part 1, 32 participants were randomized to ALG 020572 or placebo. Single doses of ALG‐020572 up to 480 mg were well tolerated. The most common treatment‐emergent adverse event reported was injection site reaction. ALG‐020572 was rapidly absorbed and plasma exposures increased with dose. In Part 2, 8 participants with non‐cirrhotic HBeAg‐negative virologically suppressed chronic hepatitis B infection were enrolled and received up to 7 doses of ALG‐020572. The study was prematurely discontinued after 4 participants experienced significant alanine aminotransferase elevations that were subsequently attributed to drug‐induced liver injury. Single doses of ALG‐020572 demonstrated a favourable pharmacokinetic and safety profile in healthy participants. Unexpectedly, ALG‐020572 was poorly tolerated in participants with chronic HBV infection, resulting in the early termination of the study and further development of ALG‐020572 due to idiosyncratic drug‐induced liver injury, suggesting caution is required in the development of this class of drugs. Trial Registration: Registered at clinicaltrials.gov : NCT0500102

papers.title: Prevalence of Hepatitis B Virus Infection in Cameroon: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
papers.abstract: Chronic hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection is a global public health problem, and many regions of Sub-Saharan Africa are disproportionately affected, including Cameroon, where prevalence has previously been shown to be high. This study aimed to provide up-to-date estimates of HBV prevalence in Cameroon. We searched Medline, Global Health, Embase, Web of Science, Cochrane Library, Africa Index Medicus and the Journal of Health Science and Disease at the University of Yaounde. We included studies reporting HBV surface antigen (HBsAg) prevalence in the general population and subpopulations. A random-effects meta-analysis was used to generate pooled estimates of HBsAg prevalence, overall and for population subgroups including those considered at relatively higher-risk and relatively lower-risk of HBV infection. Heterogeneity was assessed using the index of heterogeneity (I 2 ). Quality was assessed using the Joanna Briggs Institute critical appraisal tool. Out of 1236 records, 92 papers with 100 studies were included in the meta-analysis. Overall prevalence of HBV in Cameroon was 9.98% (95% confidence interval [CI] 9.00-11.02) with high heterogeneity (I 2 = 98.10%). The prevalences for relatively lower-risk and higher-risk populations were8.94% (95% CI 7.84-10.11) and 12.70% (95% CI 10.28-15.32), respectively. In subgroup analyses, we found that sex, geographical area (regions), population risk groups and study design were the main sources of heterogeneity. Overall, HBV prevalence remains high in Cameroon. Our findings suggest an urgent need for health interventions to halt the spread of the disease, with particular attention needed for males and regions with the highest prevalence.

papers.title_zh: 喀麦隆 患病率 感染的 患病率:系统回顾和荟萃分析。
papers.source_body_en: Chronic hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection is a global public health problem, and many regions of Sub-Saharan Africa are disproportionately affected, including Cameroon, where prevalence has previously been shown to be high. This study aimed to provide up-to-date estimates of HBV prevalence in Cameroon. We searched Medline, Global Health, Embase, Web of Science, Cochrane Library, Africa Index Medicus and the Journal of Health Science and Disease at the University of Yaounde. We included studies reporting HBV surface antigen (HBsAg) prevalence in the general population and subpopulations. A random-effects meta-analysis was used to generate pooled estimates of HBsAg prevalence, overall and for population subgroups including those considered at relatively higher-risk and relatively lower-risk of HBV infection. Heterogeneity was assessed using the index of heterogeneity (I 2 ). Quality was assessed using the Joanna Briggs Institute critical appraisal tool. Out of 1236 records, 92 papers with 100 studies were included in the meta-analysis. Overall prevalence of HBV in Cameroon was 9.98% (95% confidence interval [CI] 9.00-11.02) with high heterogeneity (I 2 = 98.10%). The prevalences for relatively lower-risk and higher-risk populations were8.94% (95% CI 7.84-10.11) and 12.70% (95% CI 10.28-15.32), respectively. In subgroup analyses, we found that sex, geographical area (regions), population risk groups and study design were the main sources of heterogeneity. Overall, HBV prevalence remains high in Cameroon. Our findings suggest an urgent need for health interventions to halt the spread of the disease, with particular attention needed for males and regions with the highest prevalence.

papers.title: Ensuring pragmatic and equitable paths forward for hepatitis B virus infection eradication in Latin America.
papers.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Latin America occupies a paradoxical position in hepatitis B virus (HBV) elimination: aggregate prevalence is low, yet the region remains far from the WHO and PAHO 2030 targets because the burden is structurally concealed within underserved populations and fragmented health systems. AREAS COVERED: This narrative review examines the regional epidemiological landscape, the structural and programmatic barriers to elimination, and a pragmatic framework focused on populations with concentrated unmet need (indigenous communities, incarcerated and displaced persons, and people living with HIV), alongside perinatal prevention, coinfection with hepatitis D virus, a defective satellite virus that requires the hepatitis B surface antigen to complete its replication cycle and produces the most rapidly progressive form of chronic viral hepatitis, endemic in the Amazon basin, and the balance between simplified and precise diagnosis in low-prevalence settings. We also consider how locally validated, equity-aware computational tools may support case-finding, risk stratification, and investment prioritization. Evidence was identified through PubMed/MEDLINE searches from January 2010 to 30 April 2026, complemented by normative and surveillance sources from WHO, PAHO, and ALEH. EXPERT OPINION: In the WHO Region of the Americas only 23% of people with chronic HBV are diagnosed and 4.5% are treated; closing this gap requires a shift from coverage-centered to precision-centered delivery, that is, reaching the right individuals and coupling decentralization to active linkage to care. HBV elimination in Latin America is best understood as a systems delivery challenge under conditions of low apparent prevalence.

papers.title_zh: 确保拉丁美洲根除 乙型肝炎病毒 感染的务实和公平的道路。
papers.source_body_en: INTRODUCTION: Latin America occupies a paradoxical position in hepatitis B virus (HBV) elimination: aggregate prevalence is low, yet the region remains far from the WHO and PAHO 2030 targets because the burden is structurally concealed within underserved populations and fragmented health systems. AREAS COVERED: This narrative review examines the regional epidemiological landscape, the structural and programmatic barriers to elimination, and a pragmatic framework focused on populations with concentrated unmet need (indigenous communities, incarcerated and displaced persons, and people living with HIV), alongside perinatal prevention, coinfection with hepatitis D virus, a defective satellite virus that requires the hepatitis B surface antigen to complete its replication cycle and produces the most rapidly progressive form of chronic viral hepatitis, endemic in the Amazon basin, and the balance between simplified and precise diagnosis in low-prevalence settings. We also consider how locally validated, equity-aware computational tools may support case-finding, risk stratification, and investment prioritization. Evidence was identified through PubMed/MEDLINE searches from January 2010 to 30 April 2026, complemented by normative and surveillance sources from WHO, PAHO, and ALEH. EXPERT OPINION: In the WHO Region of the Americas only 23% of people with chronic HBV are diagnosed and 4.5% are treated; closing this gap requires a shift from coverage-centered to precision-centered delivery, that is, reaching the right individuals and coupling decentralization to active linkage to care. HBV elimination in Latin America is best understood as a systems delivery challenge under conditions of low apparent prevalence.

papers.title: Diagnostic accuracy of dried blood spot samples for hepatitis B diagnosis: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
papers.abstract: Abstract Introduction Hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection remains a major global public health problem. Dried blood spot (DBS) sampling is simple to collect, stable during transport, and easy to store, and may therefore provide an alternative sampling strategy for decentralized HBV testing. Content PubMed, Web of Science, MEDLINE, and Cochrane were searched for English-language studies published up to August 19, 2025. Eligible studies used DBS as the index test and venous blood, serum, or plasma testing as the reference standard. Summary Forty-four studies were included, yielding 61 datasets: 36 for HBsAg, 11 for anti-HBc, and 14 for HBV DNA. Based on the bivariate random-effects model, the pooled sensitivity and specificity of DBS-based HBsAg testing were 0.943 (95 % CI, 0.916–0.962) and 0.988 (95 % CI, 0.980–0.993), respectively, with a pooled DOR of 1,995.07 (95 % CI, 834.68–4,768.66). The pooled sensitivity and specificity were 0.836 (95 % CI, 0.737–0.902) and 0.973 (95 % CI, 0.937–0.989) for DBS-based anti-HBc testing, and 0.869 (95 % CI, 0.787–0.922) and 0.963 (95 % CI, 0.932–0.980) for DBS-based HBV DNA testing, respectively. Subgroup analyses showed that specificity remained relatively stable across most subgroups. Leave-one-out sensitivity analyses showed no directional change in the overall results after omitting individual studies. Outlook DBS-based HBsAg testing showed high diagnostic accuracy, supporting its use in community screening, primary care, and resource-limited settings. DBS-based anti-HBc and HBV DNA testing also showed high specificity, but their sensitivity was relatively lower. Further standardization of sample volume, filter paper type, elution procedures, storage conditions, and positivity thresholds is needed.

papers.title: Hepatitis B surface antigen clearance rate with pegylated interferon-α therapy in different chronic hepatitis B virus infection populations: A systematic review and meta-analysis.
papers.abstract: Abstract Background: Chronic hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection is an urgent public health issue, particularly in endemic regions of Asia and sub-Saharan Africa. Achieving hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg) clearance significantly reduces the risk of hepatocellular carcinoma. Pegylated interferon alpha (PegIFNα) is widely recognized as the preferred treatment. However, the efficacy of PegIFNα in different chronic HBV infection populations has not been systematically evaluated. This study aimed to assess the HBsAg clearance rate of PegIFNα in different chronic HBV infection populations and to identify influencing factors. Methods: A systematic search was conducted in PubMed, EMBASE, the Cochrane Central Register of Controlled Trials, and the Web of Science from inception through September 28, 2022, with an update on December 6, 2023. Demographic characteristics, HBsAg clearance, and seroconversion rates were analyzed in different chronic HBV infection populations. Subgroup analyses and meta-regression were performed to explore factors influencing HBsAg clearance. Results: Of the 4867 studies screened, 115 were included in the meta-analysis. The overall HBsAg clearance rate with PegIFNα-based therapy across different chronic HBV infection populations was 16% (95% confidence interval [CI]: 13–20%). The HBsAg clearance rates at the end of treatment (EOT) were 5% (95% CI: 4–7%) in treatment-naive chronic hepatitis B (CHB) patients, 21% (95% CI: 16–26%) in nucleos(t)ide analogues (NAs)-treated CHB patients, 57% (95% CI: 48–65%) in inactive HBsAg carriers, and 22% (95% CI: 10–37%) in children with CHB. The infection population was identified as a key factor influencing HBsAg clearance and seroconversion. Conclusions: PegIFNα significantly enhances HBsAg clearance in different chronic HBV infection populations, particularly in NAs-treated patients, inactive HBsAg carriers, and children with CHB, achieving higher rates than observed with spontaneous clearance and long-term NAs therapy. Registration: PROSPERO; No.

papers.source_body_en: Abstract Background: Chronic hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection is an urgent public health issue, particularly in endemic regions of Asia and sub-Saharan Africa. Achieving hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg) clearance significantly reduces the risk of hepatocellular carcinoma. Pegylated interferon alpha (PegIFNα) is widely recognized as the preferred treatment. However, the efficacy of PegIFNα in different chronic HBV infection populations has not been systematically evaluated. This study aimed to assess the HBsAg clearance rate of PegIFNα in different chronic HBV infection populations and to identify influencing factors. Methods: A systematic search was conducted in PubMed, EMBASE, the Cochrane Central Register of Controlled Trials, and the Web of Science from inception through September 28, 2022, with an update on December 6, 2023. Demographic characteristics, HBsAg clearance, and seroconversion rates were analyzed in different chronic HBV infection populations. Subgroup analyses and meta-regression were performed to explore factors influencing HBsAg clearance. Results: Of the 4867 studies screened, 115 were included in the meta-analysis. The overall HBsAg clearance rate with PegIFNα-based therapy across different chronic HBV infection populations was 16% (95% confidence interval [CI]: 13–20%). The HBsAg clearance rates at the end of treatment (EOT) were 5% (95% CI: 4–7%) in treatment-naive chronic hepatitis B (CHB) patients, 21% (95% CI: 16–26%) in nucleos(t)ide analogues (NAs)-treated CHB patients, 57% (95% CI: 48–65%) in inactive HBsAg carriers, and 22% (95% CI: 10–37%) in children with CHB. The infection population was identified as a key factor influencing HBsAg clearance and seroconversion. Conclusions: PegIFNα significantly enhances HBsAg clearance in different chronic HBV infection populations, particularly in NAs-treated patients, inactive HBsAg carriers, and children with CHB, achieving higher rates than observed with spontaneous clearance and long-term NAs therapy. Registration: PROSPERO; No.

papers.title: Hepatitis B in Organ Transplantation-Current Evidence and Clinical Gaps.
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Over the past several decades there have been significant advances in nucleos(t)ide analogue (NA) antiviral therapy for hepatitis B virus (HBV) and global expansion of primary prevention through immunization. Despite this, HBV remains a leading cause of chronic liver disease globally, affecting over 250 million people. NA therapy has dramatically reduced the need for liver transplantation in HBV and transformed post‐transplant outcomes from historically poor to excellent. Similarly, the outcomes of kidney transplant recipients with HBV under NA therapy are now similar to those without HBV. Kidney and other non‐liver recipients, previously exposed to hepatitis B as demonstrated by a positive antibody to hepatitis B core antibody (anti‐HBc) while at risk for reactivation posttransplant have excellent outcomes when prevention strategies of either HBV monitoring or NA prophylaxis are utilized. The advances in HBV antiviral therapy have also led to increasing evidence that the organ donor pool can be expanded not only through the use of donors with positive anti‐HBc, but also those who are hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg) positive. In this review, we summarize the current state of the evidence regarding HBV amongst organ donors and recipients of liver and non‐liver organ transplants as well as the persisting gaps in evidence and opportunities for further research.

papers.title: Barriers to Hepatitis B Treatment: A Multicentre Cross-Sectional Registry and Survey Study by the Canadian Hepatitis B Network.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND & AIMS: Chronic hepatitis B (CHB) remains a leading cause of cirrhosis and hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) worldwide, yet treatment uptake is suboptimal even in high-resource settings. This pan-Canadian study aimed to quantify treatment gaps within the Canadian Hepatitis B Network (CanHepB) Registry, compare characteristics of treatment-eligible but untreated patients to those receiving therapy, and assess patient and specialist perspectives on barriers to treatment. METHODS: A cross-sectional, retrospective analysis of 1983 adults with CHB followed in 18 Canadian hepatitis B specialty clinics between January 2018 and November 2024. Treatment eligibility was determined using the 2018 Canadian Association for the Study of the Liver guidelines. An anonymous survey captured patient-reported barriers and perspectives (n = 191), while a separate survey evaluated specialist perceptions (n = 54). RESULTS: Among 881 untreated patients, 46.4% (n = 409) were treatment eligible. Compared with the treatment group (n = 1087), the treatment-eligible but untreated patients were younger (median 47.3 vs. 54.5 years), more frequently female (54.2% vs. 39.7%), and more likely to be of Black/African/Caribbean origin (18.2% vs. They had a lower prevalence of cirrhosis (2.4% vs. 20.3%), HCC (0.7% vs. 9.3%), and hypertension (17.1% vs. 22.9%), but a higher prevalence of steatotic liver disease (36.4% vs. 24.6%) and dyslipidemia (14.7% vs. Among untreated respondents, concerns included side effects, the need for long-term therapy, and lack of curative options. Conversely, specialists identified cost as the primary barrier and side effects as the least concerning. CONCLUSION: This nationwide study reveals a significant treatment gap in CHB care, driven by demographic disparities and a mismatch between patient concerns and clinician perceptions.

papers.title_zh: 乙型肝炎的障碍 治疗:加拿大乙型肝炎网络进行的多中心横断面登记和调查研究。
papers.source_body_en: BACKGROUND & AIMS: Chronic hepatitis B (CHB) remains a leading cause of cirrhosis and hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) worldwide, yet treatment uptake is suboptimal even in high-resource settings. This pan-Canadian study aimed to quantify treatment gaps within the Canadian Hepatitis B Network (CanHepB) Registry, compare characteristics of treatment-eligible but untreated patients to those receiving therapy, and assess patient and specialist perspectives on barriers to treatment. METHODS: A cross-sectional, retrospective analysis of 1983 adults with CHB followed in 18 Canadian hepatitis B specialty clinics between January 2018 and November 2024. Treatment eligibility was determined using the 2018 Canadian Association for the Study of the Liver guidelines. An anonymous survey captured patient-reported barriers and perspectives (n = 191), while a separate survey evaluated specialist perceptions (n = 54). RESULTS: Among 881 untreated patients, 46.4% (n = 409) were treatment eligible. Compared with the treatment group (n = 1087), the treatment-eligible but untreated patients were younger (median 47.3 vs. 54.5 years), more frequently female (54.2% vs. 39.7%), and more likely to be of Black/African/Caribbean origin (18.2% vs. They had a lower prevalence of cirrhosis (2.4% vs. 20.3%), HCC (0.7% vs. 9.3%), and hypertension (17.1% vs. 22.9%), but a higher prevalence of steatotic liver disease (36.4% vs. 24.6%) and dyslipidemia (14.7% vs. Among untreated respondents, concerns included side effects, the need for long-term therapy, and lack of curative options. Conversely, specialists identified cost as the primary barrier and side effects as the least concerning. CONCLUSION: This nationwide study reveals a significant treatment gap in CHB care, driven by demographic disparities and a mismatch between patient concerns and clinician perceptions.
papers.abstract_zh: 背景与目的:慢性乙型肝炎 (CHB) 仍然是全世界肝硬化和肝细胞癌 (HCC) 的主要原因,但即使在资源丰富的环境中,治疗 的摄取也不是最佳的。这项泛加拿大研究旨在量化加拿大乙型肝炎网络 (CanHepB) 注册中心内的 治疗 差距,比较符合 治疗 资格但未经治疗的患者与正在接受治疗的患者的特征,并评估患者和专家对 治疗 障碍的看法。方法:对 2018 年 1 月至 2024 年 11 月期间加拿大 18 个乙型肝炎专科诊所的 1983 名成人慢性乙型肝炎患者进行横断面回顾性分析。治疗 资格是根据 2018 年加拿大肝脏研究协会指南确定的。一项匿名调查记录了患者报告的障碍和观点 (n = 191),而另一项调查评估了专家的看法 (n = 54)。结果:在 881 名未经治疗的患者中,46.4% (n = 409) 符合 治疗 资格。与 治疗 组 (n = 1087) 相比,符合 治疗 条件但未接受治疗的患者更年轻(中位年龄 47.3 岁 vs. 54.5 岁),女性更常见(54.2% vs. 39.7%),并且更有可能是黑人/非洲/加勒比裔(18.2% vs. 他们的 患病率 较低)肝硬化(2.4% vs. 20.3%)、肝癌(0.7% vs. 9.3%)和高血压(17.1% vs. 22.9%),但脂肪变性肝病(36.4% vs. 24.6%)和血脂异常(14.7% vs. 未治疗的受访者)的 患病率 较高。在未治疗的受访者中,担忧包括副作用、需要长期治疗以及缺乏治疗。相反,专家认为成本是主要障碍,而副作用是最不令人担忧的。这项全国性研究揭示了慢性乙型肝炎护理中存在显着的 治疗 差距,这是由人口差异以及患者关注点和临床医生认知之间的不匹配造成的。

papers.title: Attendance Among People With Hepatitis B in UK Secondary Care: A Scoping Review.
papers.abstract: Chronic Hepatitis B disease requires lifelong monitoring to prevent complications such as cirrhosis and hepatocellular carcinoma. Despite structured care pathways, non-attendance within UK secondary care remains challenging. This scoping review aimed to synthesise existing evidence on factors influencing non-attendance at secondary care appointments and strategies to improve appointment adherence among people living with Chronic Hepatitis B. Eligibility Criteria: Peer-reviewed sources examining adults with Hepatitis B attendance at UK secondary care services. Grey literature was excluded. Sources of Evidence: Searches were performed in CINAHL Ultimate, Medline, Embase, Scopus and APA PsycINFO. Data were charted using a structured data extraction form and synthesised narratively. Eleven studies met the inclusion criteria. Identified barriers included patient-related factors (e.g., limited health literacy, stigmatisation, competing priorities), system-level challenges (e.g., appointment scheduling and accessibility) and cultural or language barriers. Psychological factors, including fear of diagnosis and treatment side effects, were also reported. Reported strategies included patient education, culturally tailored interventions, reminder systems (e.g., SMS and telephone calls) and integrated care models involving community outreach. Non-attendance among people with chronic Hepatitis B in secondary care is influenced by a complex interplay of personal, social and systemic factors. Interventions that address multiple barriers, particularly those that incorporate culturally sensitive approaches and reminder systems, may improve engagement. Further research is needed to co-design and evaluate interventions with affected communities.

papers.title: Hepatitis B and C Prevention, Screening, and Diagnostic Services at HIV Treatment Sites: International Epidemiology Databases to Evaluate AIDS.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Prevention, screening, and diagnostic services for hepatitis B virus (HBV) and hepatitis C virus (HCV) can prevent morbidity and mortality in people receiving HIV care. However, there is limited information about the availability of HBV and HCV services at HIV clinics globally. METHODS: The International epidemiology Databases to Evaluate AIDS (IeDEA) conducted surveys of service delivery and practices at participating HIV treatment centers from 7 regions. We used 2023 survey data to measure availability of HBV vaccination, HBV and HCV screening, HBV surface antigen (HBsAg), HBV DNA, HCV antibody, and HCV RNA testing. Multivariable logistic regression models were used to test associations of site characteristics with HBV and HCV services. RESULTS: HBV vaccination was available on-site at 67.7% of 204 HIV treatment sites. Screening for HBV and HCV at HIV care enrollment was reported by 72.1% and 50% of sites, respectively. HBsAg, HBV DNA, HCV antibody, and HCV RNA testing were available on-site at 77%, 47.6%, 61.8%, and 44.6% of sites, respectively. Sites serving predominately rural (vs. urban) populations were less likely to report on-site availability of HBV DNA [odds ratio (OR):0.07; 95% confidence interval: 0.01 to 0.68; P = 0.02], HCV antibody (OR = 0.18; 95% CI: 0.04 to 0.92; P = 0.04), and HCV RNA (OR = 0.10; 95% CI: 0.01 to 0.90; P = 0.04) testing. CONCLUSION: Life-saving services such as HBV vaccination, HBsAg, and HCV antibody testing were available on-site at most HIV treatment sites participating in the IeDEA network. Lower availability at rural sites suggests that expansion of services is important to eliminate HBV and HCV as public health problems in people receiving HIV care.

papers.title: Virologic Response to Antiviral Therapy in Chronic Hepatitis B Patients With High Viral Load: A Real-World Cohort Study.
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Current guidelines for chronic hepatitis B (CHB) have progressively expanded antiviral treatment indications, with age > 30 years increasingly being incorporated as an important criterion. However, real‐world evidence regarding treatment outcomes in this expanded population remains limited. This study evaluated the 48‐week treatment response and its independent predictors in treatment‐naïve CHB patients aged > 30 years with a high baseline viral load. This retrospective study included 808 treatment‐naïve CHB patients aged > 30 years with baseline HBV DNA ≥ 2000 IU/mL who received first‐line nucleos(t)ide analogue (NA) monotherapy. Patients were classified into moderately high (MH; ≥ 2 × 10 3 to 7 IU/mL) and extremely high (EH; ≥ 1 × 10 7 IU/mL) viral load groups. Propensity score matching (PSM) and inverse probability of treatment weighting (IPTW) were applied to adjust for baseline imbalance. At week 48, the overall virological response (VR) rate was 90.0% (727/808). Among HBeAg‐positive patients at baseline, the HBeAg seroclearance and seroconversion rates were 14.0% (59/422) and 11.8% (50/422), respectively. Compared with the MH group, the EH group had significantly lower rates of VR (81.8% vs. 95.5%, p p p 7 IU/mL were independently associated with a lower likelihood of VR. These associations remained robust after PSM and IPTW adjustment. First‐line NA therapy achieved a favourable 48‐week VR in CHB patients aged > 30 years with a high viral load. However, HBeAg positivity and extremely high viral load were associated with suboptimal response, supporting intensified monitoring and individualised management.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the virologic response to antiviral therapy in chronic hepatitis B patients over 30 years old with high baseline viral loads. It evaluates treatment outcomes in a real-world cohort of 808 patients, classifying them into moderately high (MH) and extremely high (EH) viral load groups. The results show that the overall virological response (VR) rate at week 48 was 90.0%, with the EH group having significantly lower VR rates (81.8% vs. 95.5%). Baseline HBV DNA levels ≥ 1 × 10 7 IU/mL were independently linked to reduced VR likelihood. Propensity score matching and inverse probability of treatment weighting were used to adjust for baseline imbalances. The findings suggest that HBeAg positivity and extremely high viral load are associated with suboptimal treatment responses, highlighting the need for intensified monitoring and individualized management. The study's limitations include its retrospective design, which may introduce biases, and the moderate evidence strength due to the observational approach.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 目前的 慢性乙型肝炎 (CHB) 指南已逐步扩大了 抗病毒药物 治疗 的适应症,年龄 > 30 岁越来越多地被纳入一个重要标准。然而,关于 治疗 在这一扩大的人群中的结果的现实世界证据仍然有限。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 这项回顾性研究纳入了 808 名年龄 > 30 岁、基线 HBV DNA ≥ 2000 IU/mL 且接受一线核苷类似物 (NA) 单药治疗的 808 名 治疗 初治 CHB 患者。患者被分为中高病毒载量组(MH;≥ 2 × 10 3 至 7 IU/mL)和极高病毒载量组(EH;≥ 1 × 10 7 IU/mL)。
elements_zh.methods: 应用倾向得分匹配 (PSM) 和 治疗 加权逆概率 (IPTW) 来调整基线不平衡。该研究评估了年龄 > 30 岁且基线病毒载量较高的 治疗 初治 CHB 患者的 48 周 治疗 反应及其独立预测因子。
elements_zh.main_results: 第 48 周时,总体病毒学应答 (VR) 率为 90.0% (727/808)。与 MH 组相比,EH 组的 VR 发生率显着较低(81.8% vs. 基线 HBV DNA ≥ 1 × 10 7 IU/mL 与 VR 可能性较低独立相关。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: PSM 和 IPTW 调整后,这些关联仍然强劲。一线 NA 治疗在年龄 > 30 岁且病毒载量较高的慢性乙型肝炎患者中取得了良好的 48 周 VR 效果。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: HBeAg 阳性和极高的病毒载量与次优反应相关,支持加强监测和个体化管理。这些发现为更多慢性乙型肝炎患者群体的 治疗 结局提供了见解。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究是回顾性的,可能会受到此类设计固有的偏见的影响。由于研究的观察性质和潜在的混杂因素,证据强度中等。

However, HBeAg positivity and extremely high viral load were associated with suboptimal response, supporting intensified monitoring and individualised management.

papers.title: [Rational design and translational applications of hepatitis B virus-like particles].
papers.abstract: Hepatitis B virus-like particles (HBV-VLPs), characterized by precise biomimetic topological architecture and favorable biocompatibility, have become a highly promising cutting-edge carrier in nanomedicine and immune engineering. This article systematically summarizes the latest research progress in HBV-VLPs, with focuses on the structural biological characteristics and assembly mechanisms of hepatitis B surface antigens (HBsAg) and hepatitis B core antigens (HBcAg) of HBV and the engineering strategies for expression platforms and surface functionalization modifications. In view of the challenges of assembly heterogeneity and immune response differences in the clinical applications of HBV-VLPs, this article predicts the application prospects of VLPs in reversing immune tolerance of chronic hepatitis B and constructing a liver-targeted intelligent delivery platform. Considering our empirical research on the construction of bivalent chimeric VLPs and their activation of humoral and cellular immunity, this article discusses the translational potential of transferring the multivalent co-display strategy to the HBV-VLPs system for solving immune escape. Finally, we propose a design concept for VLPs from artificial intelligence (AI)-assisted computational structural biology, aiming to provide a theoretical basis and design ideas for the development of the next generation of efficient, controllable, and multifunctional nanobiologics.

analysis.scope_and_question: This review focuses on the structural biology of hepatitis B virus (HBV) and its surface and core antigens, as well as the engineering strategies for HBV virus-like particles (VLPs). The central question is about the design and application of HBV-VLPs in nanomedicine and immune engineering, particularly in addressing immune tolerance and developing liver-targeted delivery systems.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review is a systematic summary of the latest research progress on HBV-VLPs, emphasizing structural biological characteristics, assembly mechanisms, and engineering strategies for expression platforms and surface modifications. It does not explicitly report on databases, search dates, or eligibility criteria, but it outlines the focus areas of the review.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The review highlights the potential of HBV-VLPs in reversing immune tolerance in chronic hepatitis B and constructing liver-targeted intelligent delivery platforms. It also discusses the translational potential of multivalent co-display strategies for solving immune escape issues in HBV-VLPs.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review acknowledges challenges such as assembly heterogeneity and immune response differences in the clinical applications of HBV-VLPs. These challenges suggest unresolved issues in the consistency and effectiveness of VLPs, indicating a need for further research to address these gaps.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: The review proposes a design concept for VLPs using AI-assisted computational structural biology, aiming to provide a theoretical basis for the development of next-generation nanobiologics. This suggests a priority for integrating advanced computational methods into VLP design to enhance functionality and control.

The review also discusses the challenges of assembly heterogeneity and immune response differences, suggesting the need for further research to address these gaps. Finally, it proposes an AI-assisted design concept for VLPs to advance the development of efficient and multifunctional nanobiologics.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 本综述重点介绍了乙型肝炎病毒(HBV)及其表面和核心抗原的结构生物学,以及HBV病毒样颗粒(VLP)的工程策略。核心问题是 HBV-VLP 在纳米医学和免疫工程中的设计和应用,特别是在解决免疫耐受和开发肝脏靶向递送系统方面。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 该综述系统总结了HBV-VLPs的最新研究进展,重点介绍了HBV-VLPs的结构生物学特性、组装机制以及表达平台和表面修饰的工程策略。它没有明确报告数据库、检索日期或资格标准,但概述了审查的重点领域。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 该综述强调了 HBV-VLP 在逆转 慢性乙型肝炎 免疫耐受和构建肝脏靶向智能递送平台方面的潜力。它还讨论了多价共展示策略在解决 HBV-VLP 免疫逃逸问题方面的转化潜力。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 该综述承认 HBV-VLP 临床应用中存在组装异质性和 免疫应答 差异等挑战。这些挑战表明 VLP 的一致性和有效性方面尚未解决的问题,表明需要进一步研究来解决这些差距。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 该综述提出了利用人工智能辅助计算结构生物学的VLP设计理念,旨在为下一代纳米生物制剂的开发提供理论基础。这表明应优先将先进的计算方法集成到 VLP 设计中,以增强功能和控制。

papers.title: Complete Hepatitis B Vaccination Among Health Care Professionals in Ethiopia: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis of Primary Evidence.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Despite the critical importance of HBV vaccination and Ethiopia's high burden of infection, no recent comprehensive review has synthesized data on vaccination coverage and its associated factors among Ethiopian healthcare workers. OBJECTIVE: This study aimed to determine the pooled prevalence of complete Hepatitis B Virus vaccination coverage among healthcare professionals in Ethiopia. METHODS: We searched primary articles across several databases: PubMed, Scopus, Web of Science, EMBASE, African Journals Online, and the Global Health database. Article screening, data extraction, and quality assessment were performed independently by two reviewers. We thoroughly assessed heterogeneity and publication bias, and performed subgroup analysis, sensitivity analysis, and trim-and-fill analysis. The pooled estimate for full vaccination coverage among healthcare professionals was calculated using a random-effects model with a 95% CI. RESULTS: Following a rigorous selection process, 18 primary articles involving a total of 6,167 participants were included in the final analysis. The pooled prevalence of complete vaccination against the Hepatitis B virus was found to be 29.90% (95% CI: 21.53-38.26), with considerable heterogeneity observed across the included studies (I2 = 98.6%). CONCLUSION: The pooled prevalence of complete Hepatitis B virus vaccination among healthcare professionals in Ethiopia remains suboptimal. Initiatives focused on encouraging vaccination, empowering healthcare workers with knowledge, and ensuring the vaccine is accessible and provided free of charge are recommended.

papers.abstract_zh: 背景:尽管 HBV 疫苗接种 至关重要且埃塞俄比亚的高感染负担,但最近没有全面的审查综合了埃塞俄比亚医护人员中 疫苗接种 覆盖率及其相关因素的数据。目的:本研究旨在确定埃塞俄比亚医疗保健专业人员完整 乙型肝炎病毒 疫苗接种 覆盖范围的汇总 患病率。方法:我们检索了多个数据库中的主要文章:PubMed、Scopus、Web of Science、EMBASE、African Journals Online 和 Global Health 数据库。文章筛选、数据提取和质量评估由两名审稿人独立进行。我们彻底评估了异质性和发表偏倚,并进行了亚组分析、敏感性分析和修剪填充分析。使用 CI 为 95% 的随机效应模型计算了医疗保健专业人员中 疫苗接种 全面覆盖的汇总估计值。结果:经过严格的筛选过程,最终分析纳入了 18 篇主要文章,涉及 6,167 名参与者。完整 疫苗接种 与 乙型肝炎病毒 的合并 患病率 被发现为 29.90% (95% CI: 21.53-38.26),在纳入的研究中观察到相当大的异质性 (I2 = 98.6%)。结论:埃塞俄比亚医疗保健专业人员中完整的 乙型肝炎病毒 疫苗接种 的汇总 患病率 仍然不理想。建议采取旨在鼓励 疫苗接种、为医护人员提供知识以及确保 疫苗 易于使用和免费提供的举措。

papers.title: Pradefovir mesylate and tenofovir amibufenamide for chronic hepatitis B: a systematic review and pragmatic treatment algorithm
papers.abstract: Background Pradefovir mesylate (PDV; approved in China in 2024) and tenofovir amibufenamide (TMF; approved in China in 2021) are novel hepatocyte-targeted nucleotide prodrugs recently approved in China. Their clinical positioning relative to the guideline-endorsed benchmark tenofovir alafenamide (TAF) for chronic hepatitis B management remains undefined, particularly regarding renal/bone safety and drug-drug interaction profiles. Objective To synthesize available evidence and propose a pragmatic treatment selection framework. Methods Narrative review with systematic literature search of Phase 2/3 randomized trials and observational real-world cohort studies (≥48 weeks follow-up, n ≥ 100) comparing PDV or TMF with TDF or TAF, with explicit evidence quality classification. Methods: Systematic review with qualitative synthesis of Phase 2/3 trials and observational cohorts comparing PDV or TMF with TDF or TAF. Risk of bias (RoB 2, NOS) and GRADE certainty were assessed. Results TMF demonstrated noninferior antiviral efficacy versus TDF through Week 96 with superior renal and bone safety. TMF demonstrated noninferior antiviral efficacy versus TDF through Week 96, with improved renal and bone safety profiles compared with TDF. Retrospective real-world comparisons suggest comparable efficacy to TAF; however, prospective confirmation is needed. PDV demonstrated comparable HBV DNA suppression to TDF at Week 24, with sustained efficacy and favorable safety through Week 96 in Phase 3 trials PDV showed comparable HBV DNA suppression to TDF at Week 24, with Phase 3 data at Weeks 48 and 96 now available in Chinese CHB patients. PDV’s CYP3A4-dependent activation creates clinically significant drug-drug interaction potential, whereas TMF and TAF utilize non-CYP pathways with favorable interaction profiles. PDV’s CYP3A4-dependent activation raises the theoretical possibility of drug-drug interactions based on in vitro metabolic data, whereas TMF and TAF utilize non-CYP pathways with favorable interaction profiles. Conclusion Based on currently available evidence, TMF represents a potentially viable TAF alternative for patients with renal/bone risk or anticipated long-term therapy, though definitive therapeutic equivalence requires prospective head-to-head randomized trials. PDV remains an emerging option requiring cautious implementation pending further characterization of its long-term durability, resistance barrier, and drug-drug interaction profile. Conclusion: TMF may represent an alternative to TAF for patients with renal/bone risk or anticipated long-term therapy, though definitive equivalence requires prospective head-to-head randomized trials. PDV offers comparable short-term efficacy to TDF, with longer-term data now available; continued follow-up will define its role among nucleotide prodrugs.

papers.abstract_zh: 背景甲磺酸普拉德福韦(PDV;2024年在中国批准)和阿米布芬酰胺替诺福韦(TMF;2021年在中国批准)是最近在中国批准的新型肝细胞靶向核苷酸前药。它们相对于 慢性乙型肝炎 管理指南认可的基准替诺福韦艾拉酚胺 (TAF) 的临床定位仍不确定,特别是在肾脏/骨骼安全性和药物相互作用方面。目的 综合现有证据并提出实用的 治疗 选择框架。方法 通过系统文献检索对 2/3 期随机试验和观察性真实世界 队列研究 研究(≥48 周随访,n≥100)进行叙述性回顾,将 PDV 或 TMF 与 TDF 或 TAF 进行比较,并进行明确的证据质量分类。方法:对 PDV 或 TMF 与 TDF 或 TAF 进行比较的 2/3 期试验和观察性 队列研究 定性综合进行系统评价。评估了偏倚风险(RoB 2、NOS)和 GRADE 确定性。结果 在第 96 周,TMF 证明 抗病毒药物 疗效不逊色于 TDF,并且具有卓越的肾脏和骨骼安全性。在第 96 周,TMF 表现出与 TDF 相比不劣于 抗病毒药物 的疗效,与 TDF 相比,其肾脏和骨骼安全性得到改善。回顾性现实世界比较表明,其疗效与 TAF 相当;然而,还需要前瞻性确认。PDV 在第 24 周时表现出与 TDF 相当的 HBV DNA 抑制作用,并在第 96 周的 3 期试验中具有持续的疗效和良好的安全性 PDV 在第 24 周时表现出与 TDF 相当的 HBV DNA 抑制作用,目前在中国慢性乙型肝炎患者中获得了第 48 周和第 96 周的第 3 期数据。PDV 的 CYP3A4 依赖性激活产生了临床上显着的药物相互作用潜力,而 TMF 和 TAF 利用具有良好相互作用特征的非 CYP 途径。PDV 的 CYP3A4 依赖性激活提高了基于体外代谢数据的药物相互作用的理论可能性,而 TMF 和 TAF 利用具有良好相互作用特征的非 CYP 途径。结论 根据目前现有的证据,TMF 对于有肾/骨风险或预期长期治疗的患者来说是一种潜在可行的 TAF 替代方案,尽管明确的治疗等效性需要前瞻性的头对头随机试验。PDV 仍然是一种新兴选择,需要谨慎实施,等待其长期耐久性、耐药屏障和药物相互作用特征的进一步表征。结论:对于有肾/骨风险或预期长期治疗的患者来说,TMF 可能是 TAF 的替代方案,尽管最终的等效性需要前瞻性头对头随机试验。PDV 提供与 TDF 相当的短期疗效,且现已提供长期数据;持续的随访将确定其在核苷酸前药中的作用。

papers.title: Peripheral Biomarkers in Chronic Hepatitis D Infection: A Review.
papers.abstract: Chronic hepatitis D represents the most severe form of viral hepatitis and is associated with higher rates of advanced fibrosis, cirrhosis and hepatocellular carcinoma than hepatitis B monoinfection. It is caused by the hepatitis D virus (HDV), a defective RNA virus that requires co-infection with hepatitis B (HBV) for hepatocyte entry and propagation. Accurate prediction of liver disease sequelae and treatment response using currently available serological biomarkers remains challenging. This article reviews peripheral biomarkers in HDV, including novel biomarkers of HBV activity, exploring their potential clinical utility and areas for future development. Peripheral biomarkers capable of risk stratifying patients with HDV, monitoring or predicting treatment response and elucidating the natural history of infection (including the complex relationship with HBV), would enable individualised care and early identification of those at greater risk of developing advanced liver disease. Establishing the role of these biomarkers in larger, ethnically diverse populations both on existing treatments and in the context of emerging antiviral therapies will be imperative going forward.

It is caused by the hepatitis D virus (HDV), a defective RNA virus that requires co-infection with hepatitis B (HBV) for hepatocyte entry and propagation. Accurate prediction of liver disease sequelae and treatment response using currently available serological biomarkers remains challenging. This article reviews peripheral biomarkers in HDV, including novel biomarkers of HBV activity, exploring their potential clinical utility and areas for future development. Peripheral biomarkers capable of risk stratifying patients with HDV, monitoring or predicting treatment response and elucidating the natural history of infection (including the complex relationship with HBV), would enable individualised care and early identification of those at greater risk of developing advanced liver disease. Establishing the role of these biomarkers in larger, ethnically diverse populations both on existing treatments and in the context of emerging antiviral therapies will be imperative going forward.

papers.title: Enhancing Hepatitis B case finding through tech-enhanced community pharmacy: Results from a trial program in Vietnam.
papers.abstract: Hepatitis B virus (HBV) remains a major public health challenge in Vietnam. Barriers include limited awareness and access to screening as well as out-of-pocket diagnosis and treatment costs. Point-of-care rapid diagnostic tests (RDTs) offer an opportunity to expand screening and linkages to diagnosis and care. This intervention assessed technology-enhanced community pharmacies ability to provide HBV screening and find cases in Vietnam using digital monitoring and cross-sectional digital survey data. Between February 2024 and March 2025, SwipeRx partnered with the Vietnamese Pharmaceutical Association and the commercial supplier of Determine HBsAg-RDT to implement a trial program including digital campaigns, accredited digital training, in-pharmacy and mobile coaching, and supplier linkages. Monitoring and cross-sectional digital survey data were used to assess changes in HBV knowledge and practices at the pharmacy. Among 917 pharmacists who completed the accredited online training, 117 pharmacies with at least 1 trained pharmacist received coaching and procured 5,900 HBsAg-RDTs, with 48% placing repeat orders. During the same six-month period, 84% (98/117) of pharmacies identified 270 pharmacy clients who tested positive out of 2,840 unique clients screened using HBsAg-RDT prior to referral to a nearby health facility for confirmatory HBV diagnosis. Pharmacists who completed the digital training and were engaged with digital campaigns and coaching were 2.83 times more likely to stock HBsAg-RDT and reported significantly higher HBV-related knowledge and confidence compared to non-engaged pharmacists. This research demonstrates how technology-enabled training and pharmacy engagement can facilitate community access to new health products and services, including HBV screening. Optimizing test packaging, pricing, and pharmacy client demand may further expand access to and uptake of HBV screening through community pharmacies in future.

papers.title_zh: 通过技术增强的社区药房加强乙型肝炎病例发现:越南试验计划的结果。
papers.source_body_en: Hepatitis B virus (HBV) remains a major public health challenge in Vietnam. Barriers include limited awareness and access to screening as well as out-of-pocket diagnosis and treatment costs. Point-of-care rapid diagnostic tests (RDTs) offer an opportunity to expand screening and linkages to diagnosis and care. This intervention assessed technology-enhanced community pharmacies ability to provide HBV screening and find cases in Vietnam using digital monitoring and cross-sectional digital survey data. Between February 2024 and March 2025, SwipeRx partnered with the Vietnamese Pharmaceutical Association and the commercial supplier of Determine HBsAg-RDT to implement a trial program including digital campaigns, accredited digital training, in-pharmacy and mobile coaching, and supplier linkages. Monitoring and cross-sectional digital survey data were used to assess changes in HBV knowledge and practices at the pharmacy. Among 917 pharmacists who completed the accredited online training, 117 pharmacies with at least 1 trained pharmacist received coaching and procured 5,900 HBsAg-RDTs, with 48% placing repeat orders. During the same six-month period, 84% (98/117) of pharmacies identified 270 pharmacy clients who tested positive out of 2,840 unique clients screened using HBsAg-RDT prior to referral to a nearby health facility for confirmatory HBV diagnosis. Pharmacists who completed the digital training and were engaged with digital campaigns and coaching were 2.83 times more likely to stock HBsAg-RDT and reported significantly higher HBV-related knowledge and confidence compared to non-engaged pharmacists. This research demonstrates how technology-enabled training and pharmacy engagement can facilitate community access to new health products and services, including HBV screening. Optimizing test packaging, pricing, and pharmacy client demand may further expand access to and uptake of HBV screening through community pharmacies in future.

papers.title: Current policies and practices for testing and treatment of chronic hepatitis B and C infection in high-burden countries in the WHO European region
papers.abstract: Abstract Chronic hepatitis B and hepatitis C remain major public health concerns in the WHO European Region, where an estimated 10.6 million people were living with HBV infection and 7.7 million with HCV infection in 2022. Despite this substantial burden, diagnosis and treatment coverage remain low, posing a significant challenge to achieving the WHO regional goal of viral hepatitis elimination by 2030. To assess country-level progress and gaps in hepatitis testing and treatment, the WHO Regional Office for Europe conducted a survey among nine high burden countries, receiving responses from eight: Armenia, Azerbaijan, Belarus, Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, the Republic of Moldova, Turkmenistan and Uzbekistan. The survey examined national policies, testing availability, treatment regimens, service delivery approaches, and key implementation barriers. Most countries reported having national HBV and HCV guidelines aligned with international standards, although planned updates were inconsistent. Point of care PCR viral load testing was available in five countries, but coverage of test costs varied, and reflex PCR testing had been implemented in only four. First line antiviral regimens largely followed international guidance; however, medication prices and national coverage differed considerably, with out of pocket payment requirements persisting in several settings. All countries reported the use of non invasive tests for liver disease staging, though coverage for elastography remains limited. Service delivery has become increasingly decentralized, with HBV and HCV testing and care available across multiple levels of the health system and integrated into primary care and HIV clinics in most countries. Nevertheless, provision of HCV treatment in harm reduction settings remains rare, limiting access for populations at highest risk. Overall, the findings indicate strong political commitment but highlight persistent gaps in testing access, treatment affordability, and service delivery models. Addressing these gaps through tailored country specific strategies, expanded financial protection, and strengthened integration of services will be essential to accelerate progress toward the 2030 elimination targets.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 此次审查的重点是世卫组织欧洲地区高负担国家的人类 乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV) 感染检测和 Z​​XQTERMVQXZ 政策。它检查了 HBV 相关疾病的范围,包括 慢性乙型肝炎、急性乙型肝炎、HBV 相关肝细胞癌和 HBV 相关肝硬化。核心问题是评估国家级 HBV 检测和 Z​​XQTERMVQXZ 方面的进展和差距。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 该审查基于世界卫生组织欧洲区域办事处对九个高负担国家进行的一项调查,并收到了八个国家的答复。该调查审查了国家政策、检测可用性、治疗 方案、服务提供方法和实施障碍。证据包括有关床旁 PCR 检测、非侵入性肝病分期检测和一线 抗病毒药物 方案可用性的报告。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 大多数国家报告说,其国家乙型肝炎指南与国际标准保持一致,但计划的更新不一致。所有国家都使用了肝病分期的非侵入性检测,但弹性成像的覆盖范围仍然有限。服务提供已变得分散,大多数国家的乙型肝炎检测和护理已纳入初级保健和艾滋病毒诊所。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 该审查强调了测试访问、治疗 负担能力和服务交付模型方面持续存在的差距。HCV 治疗 在减低危害环境中仍然很少见,限制了高危人群的接触。证据还指出,药品价格和国家覆盖范围存在很大差异,在一些情况下仍然存在自付费用要求。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 通过针对具体国家量身定制的战略、扩大金融保护和加强服务一体化来弥补这些差距,对于加快实现 2030 年消除目标至关重要。该审查强调需要改善检测和 Z​​XQTERMVQXZ 的可及性,特别是在减少伤害的环境中,并解决药物的可负担性问题。

papers.title: Candidate epistatic mutation clusters in occult hepatitis B virus genotype D: a critical narrative review of the evidence gap and a proposed testable framework
papers.abstract: Hepatitis B virus (HBV) genotype D is the dominant genotype across the Middle East. It forms the background against which diagnostic assays, blood-screening algorithms, and vaccination programmes operate in the region. Occult hepatitis B infection (OBI), the presence of replication-competent HBV DNA in individuals who test negative for hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg), remains a persistent challenge for diagnosis, for transfusion and transplant safety, and for the management of immunosuppressed patients. Individual surface-protein escape mutations are well characterised, yet they account only incompletely for the full spectrum of OBI. It is not yet established whether combinations of co-occurring surface mutations interact non-additively, that is epistatically, to influence HBsAg detectability, secretion, or replication in genotype D, whether such combinations are enriched in Middle Eastern populations, or whether they are shaped by HIV or HCV coinfection. The functional and structural data required to answer these questions are largely absent. We critically appraise the available evidence, separate established findings from extrapolation and hypothesis using an explicit grading scheme, and propose a testable bioinformatic and experimental framework to determine whether candidate epistatic clusters contribute to OBI in genotype D. We propose and apply a four-level evidence hierarchy distinguishing co-occurrence, phylogenetically corrected covariation, experimental single-versus-combination comparison, and mechanistic validation. Against this hierarchy, published data on HBsAg mutation clusters in genotype D reach Level 1–2 at most; the decisive Level 3 experiment, site-directed reconstruction of candidate clusters versus their constituent single mutants on a defined genotype D backbone, has not been performed. Genotype-D-specific and Middle-East-specific datasets adequate for cluster-level analysis are limited, direct evidence linking coinfection to selection of mutation clusters is absent, and structural inference remains constrained because recent cryo-EM structures of HBsAg subviral particles do not resolve the ‘a’ determinant loops at the resolution required to interpret mutation-cluster-level conformational perturbations. Epistasis is a biologically plausible, under-tested mechanism that may help explain why single mutations incompletely account for OBI. It should not be presented as an established driver. We define the sequencing, functional, structural, and clinical studies required to test the hypothesis directly, and we identify the methodological safeguards, particularly phylogenetic correction, that any such effort must adopt.

analysis.summary_en: This review explores the role of epistatic mutation clusters in occult hepatitis B infection (OBI) in HBV genotype D, which is dominant in the Middle East. It highlights the limitations of current evidence, noting that while individual surface-protein escape mutations are well characterised, they do not fully account for OBI. The review proposes a four-level evidence hierarchy to assess the impact of mutation clusters on HBsAg detectability, secretion, or replication. It identifies the need for experimental single-versus-combination comparisons and mechanistic validation, which have not yet been conducted. The review also underscores the lack of genotype-D-specific and Middle-East-specific datasets, as well as the absence of direct evidence linking coinfection to mutation cluster selection. Finally, it calls for further research to address these gaps and test the hypothesis that epistasis may explain the incomplete understanding of OBI in genotype D.

papers.abstract_zh: 乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV) D 基因型是整个中东地区的主导基因型。它构成了诊断分析、血液筛查算法和 疫苗接种 程序在该地区运行的背景。隐匿性乙型肝炎感染 (OBI),即乙型肝炎表面抗原 (HBsAg) 检测阴性的个体中存在具有复制能力的 HBV DNA,对于 诊断、输血和移植安全以及免疫抑制患者的管理来说,仍然是一个持续的挑战。单个表面蛋白逃逸 突变 得到了很好的表征,但它们只能不完全地解释 OBI 的全谱。目前尚不清楚共存表面 突变 的组合是否非加性地相互作用(即上位性相互作用)以影响基因型 D 中 HBsAg 的可检测性、分泌或复制,此类组合是否在中东人群中富集,或者它们是否由 HIV 或 HCV 共感染形成。回答这些问题所需的功能和结构数据基本上不存在。我们批判性地评估现有证据,使用明确的分级方案将已建立的发现与外推和假设分开,并提出一个可测试的生物信息学和实验框架,以确定候选上位簇是否有助于基因型 D 中的 OBI。我们提出并应用四级证据层次结构,区分共现、系统发育校正的共变、实验单一与组合比较和机制验证。与此等级相比,已发表的 D 基因型 HBsAg 突变 簇的数据最多达到 1-2 级;决定性的 3 级实验,即候选簇与其在确定的基因型 D 主干上的组成单突变体的定点重建,尚未进行。足以进行簇级分析的基因型 D 特异性和中东特异性数据集有限,缺乏将共感染与 突变 簇选择联系起来的直接证据,并且结构推断仍然受到限制,因为最近 HBsAg 亚病毒颗粒的冷冻电镜结构不能以解释 突变 簇级构象扰动所需的分辨率解析“a”决定环。上位性是一种生物学上合理的、未经测试的机制,可能有助于解释为什么单个 突变 不能完全解释 OBI。它不应该作为已建立的驱动程序呈现。我们定义了直接检验假设所需的测序、功能、结构和临床研究,并确定了任何此类努力必须采用的方法学保障措施,特别是系统发育校正。

analysis_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 目前尚不清楚共存表面 突变 的组合是否非加性地相互作用,即上位性地相互作用,以影响基因型 D 中 HBsAg 的可检测性、分泌或复制。足以进行聚类水平分析的基因型 D 特异性和中东特异性数据集是有限的。缺乏将共感染与 突变 簇选择联系起来的直接证据。结构推断仍然受到限制,因为最近 HBsAg 亚病毒颗粒的冷冻电镜结构无法以解释 突变 簇级构象扰动所需的分辨率解析“a”行列式环。
analysis_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 回答这些问题所需的功能和结构数据基本上不存在。该综述提出并应用了四级证据层次结构来确定候选上位簇是否有助于基因型 D 中的 OBI。它不应作为既定驱动因素提出。

papers.title: Geospatial Discrepancy of Chronic Hepatitis B and Hepatitis D Testing in Alberta: A Population-Based Spatial Analysis.
papers.abstract: Chronic hepatitis B (CHB) and hepatitis D virus (HDV) coinfection are major causes of cirrhosis and hepatocellular carcinoma. The geographic distribution of CHB and alignment of anti-HDV testing with CHB burden remain poorly defined. We aimed to examine if anti-HDV testing and seropositivity align with areas of highest CHB burden. Adults with CHB (2014-2022) were identified using a validated serologic algorithm in the provincial laboratory database capturing HBV/HDV serology. Cases were geolocated to Aggregate Dissemination Areas (ADAs), linked to Alberta Health Services zones and rural-urban continuum levels. Age- and sex-standardized CHB prevalence was calculated per ADA using the 2016 Canadian Census. Descriptive mapping, global spatial autocorrelation and local hotspot analysis were used to assess spatial clustering. Among 8317 persons with CHB, the provincial age- and sex-standardized prevalence was 1.70 per 1000 population (95% CI, 1.66-1.74). Prevalence ranged from 2.15 per 1000 in metropolitan areas to 0.40 per 1000 in remote regions and was higher in Calgary than Edmonton (2.53 vs. Overall, 17.5% of CHB patients were tested for anti-HDV, and 4.1% of those tested were anti-HDV positive. CHB prevalence hotspots were concentrated in metropolitan ADAs, whereas hotspots of anti-HDV testing and positivity showed only partial overlap with these high-burden areas. CHB burden in Alberta is geographically clustered, particularly within specific neighbourhoods of metropolitan cities, whereas anti-HDV testing remains infrequent and only partially aligned with high-burden areas. Reflex or systematic anti-HDV testing, paired with geographically informed outreach, may improve case detection.

papers.title: Seroprevalence update of Hepatitis B Virus, Hepatitis C Virus, and human immunodeficiency virus among people who inject drugs in Kuwait: a cross-sectional study at a national addiction treatment center
papers.abstract: Abstract Background People who inject drugs (PWID) represent a key population disproportionately affected by blood-borne viruses. Updated epidemiological data are crucial for informing public health interventions. This study provides a 2024 update on the seroprevalence and correlates of Hepatitis B (HBV), Hepatitis C (HCV), and Human Immunodeficiency Virus (HIV) among PWID at Kuwait’s national addiction treatment center, building on a previous 2017 baseline. Methods A cross-sectional study was conducted from January to December 2024, enrolling 1,287 consecutive patients. Serological screening for HBsAg, anti-HCV, and anti-HIV was performed using chemiluminescent immunoassays. Seropositive samples underwent confirmatory nucleic acid testing to detect active viremia. Multivariable logistic regression was used to identify factors associated with each infection. Results The cohort was predominantly male (86.6%) and Kuwaiti (87.3%), with a median age of 33 years. The overall seroprevalence was 0.2% for HBsAg (2/1,255), 2.1% for anti-HCV (25/1,169), and 0.93% for anti-HIV (12/1,287). A significant age-dependent increase in HCV prevalence was observed ( p < 0.001), with the highest prevalence (10.8%) in participants aged ≥ 50 years. All HIV-positive cases were male. Molecular testing revealed universal active viremia for HCV (100%, 25/25) and HBV (100%, 2/2), and detectable viremia in 66.7% (8/12) of HIV-seropositive cases. In multivariable analysis, increasing age was significantly associated with HCV infection (aOR = 1.1, 95% CI: 1.07–1.16, p < 0.001). For HIV, female sex was associated with significantly lower odds of infection (aOR = 0.14, 95% CI: 0.02–0.92, p = 0.04). Due to the extremely low number of HBV-reactive cases ( n = 2), multivariable logistic regression was not feasible for HBV, and no adjusted estimates could be derived. Conclusion Compared to 2017 data, this study reveals a concerning increase in HIV prevalence and a shift to universal active HCV viremia among PWID in Kuwait. The near-ubiquitous presence of transmissible infection upon seroconversion indicates a critical gap in the care cascade. These findings underscore an urgent need for the scale-up of targeted harm reduction, test-and-treat strategies, and integrated care services to curb transmission.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在更新科威特注射吸毒者 (PWID) 中的 乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV)、丙型肝炎病毒 (HCV) 和人类免疫缺陷病毒 (HIV) 的 血清流行率,因为 PWID 是受血源性病毒影响尤为严重的关键人群。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 2024 年 1 月至 12 月,科威特国家成瘾 治疗 中心进行了一项横断面研究,连续招募了 1,287 名患者。队列研究 以男性 (86.6%) 和科威特人 (87.3%) 为主,中位年龄为 33 岁。
elements_zh.methods: 使用化学发光免疫分析对 HBsAg、抗 HCV 和抗 HIV 进行血清学筛查。对血清阳性样本进行验证性核酸检测,以检测活性病毒血症。使用多变量逻辑回归来确定与每次感染相关的因素,但 HBV 除外,因为 HBV 反应病例数极低 (n = 2)。
elements_zh.main_results: The overall seroprevalence was 0.2% for HBsAg (2/1,255), 2.1% for anti-HCV (25/1,169), and 0.93% for anti-HIV (12/1,287). Molecular testing revealed universal active viremia for HCV (100%, 25/25) and HBV (100%, 2/2), and detectable viremia in 66.7% (8/12) of HIV-seropositive cases. A significant age-dependent increase in HCV prevalence was observed (p < 0.001), with the highest prevalence (10.8%) in participants aged ≥ 50 years. All HIV-positive cases were male. Female sex was associated with significantly lower odds of HIV infection (aOR = 0.14, 95% CI: 0.02–0.92, p = 0.04).
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该研究揭示了与 2017 年数据相比,科威特吸毒者中 HIV 患病率 的增加令人担忧,并且普遍存在活动性 HCV 病毒血症。血清转化后传播性感染几乎无处不在,这表明护理级联中存在严重缺口。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现强调,迫切需要扩大有针对性的减少伤害、检测和治疗策略以及综合护理服务,以遏制科威特吸毒者中的 传播。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 乙肝病毒反应病例数极低 (n = 2),限制了乙肝病毒调整后估计值的能力。由于横截面设计和潜在的混杂因素,证据是中等的。

papers.title_zh: 血清流行率 科威特注射吸毒者中 乙型肝炎病毒、丙型肝炎病毒和人类免疫缺陷病毒的最新情况:国家成瘾 治疗 中心的横断面研究
papers.source_body_en: Abstract Background People who inject drugs (PWID) represent a key population disproportionately affected by blood-borne viruses. Updated epidemiological data are crucial for informing public health interventions. This study provides a 2024 update on the seroprevalence and correlates of Hepatitis B (HBV), Hepatitis C (HCV), and Human Immunodeficiency Virus (HIV) among PWID at Kuwait’s national addiction treatment center, building on a previous 2017 baseline. Methods A cross-sectional study was conducted from January to December 2024, enrolling 1,287 consecutive patients. Serological screening for HBsAg, anti-HCV, and anti-HIV was performed using chemiluminescent immunoassays. Seropositive samples underwent confirmatory nucleic acid testing to detect active viremia. Multivariable logistic regression was used to identify factors associated with each infection. Results The cohort was predominantly male (86.6%) and Kuwaiti (87.3%), with a median age of 33 years. The overall seroprevalence was 0.2% for HBsAg (2/1,255), 2.1% for anti-HCV (25/1,169), and 0.93% for anti-HIV (12/1,287). A significant age-dependent increase in HCV prevalence was observed ( p < 0.001), with the highest prevalence (10.8%) in participants aged ≥ 50 years. All HIV-positive cases were male. Molecular testing revealed universal active viremia for HCV (100%, 25/25) and HBV (100%, 2/2), and detectable viremia in 66.7% (8/12) of HIV-seropositive cases. In multivariable analysis, increasing age was significantly associated with HCV infection (aOR = 1.1, 95% CI: 1.07–1.16, p < 0.001). For HIV, female sex was associated with significantly lower odds of infection (aOR = 0.14, 95% CI: 0.02–0.92, p = 0.04). Due to the extremely low number of HBV-reactive cases ( n = 2), multivariable logistic regression was not feasible for HBV, and no adjusted estimates could be derived. Conclusion Compared to 2017 data, this study reveals a concerning increase in HIV prevalence and a shift to universal active HCV viremia among PWID in Kuwait. The near-ubiquitous presence of transmissible infection upon seroconversion indicates a critical gap in the care cascade. These findings underscore an urgent need for the scale-up of targeted harm reduction, test-and-treat strategies, and integrated care services to curb transmission.

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在更新科威特注射吸毒者 (PWID) 中的 乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV)、丙型肝炎病毒 (HCV) 和人类免疫缺陷病毒 (HIV) 的 血清流行率,因为 PWID 是受血源性病毒影响尤为严重的关键人群。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 2024 年 1 月至 12 月,科威特国家成瘾 治疗 中心进行了一项横断面研究,连续招募了 1,287 名患者。队列研究 以男性 (86.6%) 和科威特人 (87.3%) 为主,中位年龄为 33 岁。
analysis_zh.methods: 使用化学发光免疫分析对 HBsAg、抗 HCV 和抗 HIV 进行血清学筛查。对血清阳性样本进行验证性核酸检测,以检测活性病毒血症。使用多变量逻辑回归来确定与每次感染相关的因素,但 HBV 除外,因为 HBV 反应病例数极低 (n = 2)。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该研究揭示了与 2017 年数据相比,科威特吸毒者中 HIV 患病率 的增加令人担忧,并且普遍存在活动性 HCV 病毒血症。血清转化后传播性感染几乎无处不在,这表明护理级联中存在严重缺口。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现强调,迫切需要扩大有针对性的减少伤害、检测和治疗策略以及综合护理服务,以遏制科威特吸毒者中的 传播。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 乙肝病毒反应病例数极低 (n = 2),限制了乙肝病毒调整后估计值的能力。由于横截面设计和潜在的混杂因素,证据是中等的。

papers.title: Differential Hepatitis B Surface Antigen Glycan Isomer Kinetics Between Tenofovir Alafenamide and Entecavir: Hepatocellular Carcinoma Risk Stratification in Hepatitis B e Antigen-Positive Patients.
papers.abstract: Nucleos(t)ide analog (NA) therapy suppresses hepatitis B virus (HBV) DNA, but residual hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) risk persists. O-glycosylated hepatitis B surface antigen glycan isomer (HBsAgGi) uniquely reflects virion burden. We evaluated the impact of tenofovir alafenamide (TAF) versus entecavir (ETV) on 48-week HBsAgGi kinetics and its utility in stratifying HCC risk in 90 NA-naïve patients (ETV: 73; TAF: 17). A favourable response was defined as a reduction or maintenance of low HBsAgGi levels. TAF independently predicted a favourable response compared with ETV (penalised odds ratio 3.60, p = 0.030). A significant interaction occurred between HBeAg status and HBsAgGi response in relation to HCC development (p = 0.038). In HBeAg-positive patients, a poor response was associated with increased HCC risk (hazard ratio 7.34, 95% confidence interval [CI] 1.96-20.35, p = 0.001); however, the exact magnitude warrants cautious interpretation due to wide CIs. This association was absent in HBeAg-negative cases. Adding HBsAgGi response to the aMAP score improved long-term HCC prediction exclusively in the HBeAg-positive cohort. As the assay targets genotype C-specific O-glycosylation, the findings cannot be generalised to genotypes A, B, or D. In conclusion, on-treatment HBsAgGi response is a specific surrogate marker for stratifying residual HCC risk in HBeAg-positive patients, and TAF is more effective than ETV in inducing these favourable kinetics.

papers.source_body_en: Nucleos(t)ide analog (NA) therapy suppresses hepatitis B virus (HBV) DNA, but residual hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) risk persists. O-glycosylated hepatitis B surface antigen glycan isomer (HBsAgGi) uniquely reflects virion burden. We evaluated the impact of tenofovir alafenamide (TAF) versus entecavir (ETV) on 48-week HBsAgGi kinetics and its utility in stratifying HCC risk in 90 NA-naïve patients (ETV: 73; TAF: 17). A favourable response was defined as a reduction or maintenance of low HBsAgGi levels. TAF independently predicted a favourable response compared with ETV (penalised odds ratio 3.60, p = 0.030). A significant interaction occurred between HBeAg status and HBsAgGi response in relation to HCC development (p = 0.038). In HBeAg-positive patients, a poor response was associated with increased HCC risk (hazard ratio 7.34, 95% confidence interval [CI] 1.96-20.35, p = 0.001); however, the exact magnitude warrants cautious interpretation due to wide CIs. This association was absent in HBeAg-negative cases. Adding HBsAgGi response to the aMAP score improved long-term HCC prediction exclusively in the HBeAg-positive cohort. As the assay targets genotype C-specific O-glycosylation, the findings cannot be generalised to genotypes A, B, or D. In conclusion, on-treatment HBsAgGi response is a specific surrogate marker for stratifying residual HCC risk in HBeAg-positive patients, and TAF is more effective than ETV in inducing these favourable kinetics.

papers.title: On‐Treatment Reassessment of Type IV Collagen 7S and M2BPGi‐Qt Improves Long‐Term Hepatocellular Carcinoma Risk Stratification in Chronic Hepatitis B
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Aims Hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) remains a major complication in patients with chronic hepatitis B receiving nucleos(t)ide analogue (NA) therapy despite effective viral suppression. Although on‐treatment assessment of indirect fibrosis indices has been associated with HCC risk, the prognostic value of direct fibrosis markers, particularly type IV collagen 7S (4COL7S), during antiviral therapy remains poorly defined. We investigated whether on‐treatment 4COL7S predicts HCC development, with M2BPGi‐Qt evaluated as a supportive comparator. Methods This retrospective cohort study included 319 patients with chronic hepatitis B who initiated NA therapy. Serum 4COL7S and M2BPGi‐Qt were measured at baseline and 1 year after treatment initiation. The primary endpoint was HCC development. Landmark, Kaplan–Meier, and multivariable Cox analyses were performed. Results During a median follow‐up of 12.6 years, 45 patients (14.1%) developed HCC. Baseline 4COL7S and M2BPGi‐Qt did not significantly stratify cumulative HCC incidence. In contrast, elevated 1‐year levels of both markers were significantly associated with increased HCC risk. In multivariable analyses, 1‐year 4COL7S remained independently associated with subsequent HCC development after adjustment for baseline mPAGE‐B, 1‐year HBsAg‐HQ, and 1‐year HBcrAg (adjusted hazard ratio [HR], 1.167; 95% confidence interval [CI], 1.001–1.344; p = 0.042). M2BPGi‐Qt showed consistent supportive findings (adjusted HR, 1.272; 95% CI, 1.101–1.468; p = 0.001). Conclusions On‐treatment 4COL7S was independently associated with subsequent HCC development and may serve as a novel direct fibrosis marker for long‐term risk stratification in NA‐treated chronic hepatitis B. M2BPGi‐Qt provided supportive prognostic information, underscoring the clinical relevance of reassessing residual fibrosis‐related risk after antiviral treatment initiation.
